title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The signal the watcher waits on is now checked
summary: The scanner counts the work it has in flight and the watcher waits on it. Nothing checked that the count comes back down, and a stuck count would have stopped a repair silently.

highlights.title: No behaviour change
highlights.description: Every watcher test supplies its own stand in for that signal, so none of them could see the real one going wrong.

sections.heading: Internal
bullets: Checked on the paths that are not the happy one: unreadable file, mixed batch, cancelled scan.
Seven hundred mixed events with real background threads leave the index equal to the filesystem and the count back at zero.
